title: Optimising Cryogenic Wiring for Microwave-frequency Millikelvin Quantum Processors
summary: Cryogenic capacity is a key bottleneck in the scaling of superconducting quantum processors, critically impacted by control wiring. Currently, wiring architectures are often designed following a small set of "best-practice" heuristics, little changed since they emerged for early, small-scale systems, and not rigorously evaluated for wider contexts. Here, we adopt a whole-system numerical modelling approach and present a systematic optimisation for the coaxial wiring design of a superconducting quantum processor.
